description: This file defines a template class 'StateTrigger' used for managing and waiting on state changes, including synchronization mechanisms like locking and event signaling. It provides methods for setting, getting, and waiting for specific states, and is part of the 'Thunder::Core' namespace.

classes.name: StateTrigger<enumerate>
classes.description: A template class for managing state transitions and synchronization, with methods for waiting on states, setting states, and comparison operators.

methods.name: WaitState
methods.description: Waits until the specified state is reached or timeout occurs.

methods.name: WaitStateClear
methods.description: Waits until the specified state is cleared or timeout occurs.

methods.name: SetState
methods.description: Sets the current state and signals waiting threads if state changes.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks if the current state equals the given state.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks if the current state does not equal the given state.
